newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA INVEST TO TEST ASA MARKET PRICE.
newsitem.headline: HANSA INVEST TO TEST ASA MARKET PRICE.

text.p: Hansa Investments, leading the share issue for ASA Insurance, said on Tuesday it will offer shares to various financial institutions before a public offer starts to determine at what price to set the shares.
"After that there will be a public offer of 350,000 shares or 3.5 million kroons," Hansa Investments vice-director Viktor Mahhov said in a statement.
ASA shareholders last week approved an 3.5 million kroons and a plan to get a bourse listing by the middle of June.
ASA 1996 turnover was 125 million kroons and its net profit was one million kroons compared to 91.9 million kroons and 1.3 million kroons in 1995.
Its share capital is 25.4 million kroons and equity 32.1 million kroons.
